text: Final categorization: EXCLUDED (Justification: The paper is a non-review research article focused on soil organic carbon (SOC) sequestration under climate change and compost amendment scenarios, not on land use/land cover (LULC) prediction. Although it uses fixed land use classes from the Corine Land Cover database as input, it assumes no change in land use over time (i.e., land use is held constant), so there is no LULC prediction or simulation component. The study models SOC dynamics spatially at the national scale under multiple climate and management scenarios, but this falls under carbon/biogeochemical modeling, which is explicitly excluded per the criterion: "Biomass/bioenergy/carbon studies without LULC change analysis." While the paper includes mapped outputs of SOC change, it does not produce or analyze future LULC maps or transitions, nor is LULC prediction part of its methodology or objective.)
